test("[TA-BR-01] (primary) BankTaBridgePort.ingestOutcome -> reject TA_UNKNOWN_ORIGINAL", () => {
  const pins: Array<{ artifact: string; inputs: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> }> = [];
  const dispatches: Array<{ target: string; payload: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> }> = [];
  const externValues = {"submissionPinned":false,"taReceiptAuthentic":false,"taOutcomeConfirmed":false,"taOutcomeRejected":false,"taAbsenceConfirmed":false};
  const externs: TaBridgeSettlementExternPorts = {
    submissionPinned: () => externValues["submissionPinned"],
    taReceiptAuthentic: () => externValues["taReceiptAuthentic"],
    taOutcomeConfirmed: () => externValues["taOutcomeConfirmed"],
    taOutcomeRejected: () => externValues["taOutcomeRejected"],
    taAbsenceConfirmed: () => externValues["taAbsenceConfirmed"],
  };
  const effects: TaBridgeSettlementEffectsPort = {
    pin(artifact, inputs) { pins.push({ artifact, inputs }); },
    dispatch(target, payload) { dispatches.push({ target, payload }); },
  };
  const req = { operation: "BankTaBridgePort.ingestOutcome", payload: {"orderId":""}, stateSnapshot: {} };
  const outcome = taBridgeSettlementHandler.handle(req, externs, effects);
  assert.equal(outcome.ok, false, "expected application rejection");
  if (!outcome.ok) {
    assert.equal(outcome.code, "TA_UNKNOWN_ORIGINAL");
  }
  assert.equal(dispatches.length, 0, "rejected request must not dispatch commands");
});

// @CoArisingSpec(id="TA-BR-03", witness="z3-qf_auflia-ta-br-03-primary")
test("[TA-BR-03] (primary) BankTaBridgePort.ingestOutcome -> dispatch FundOrder.RecordFundTAConfirmed and forbid dispatch FundOrder.RequestIndependentRefund and respond TaBridgeAcknowledgement", () => {
  const pins: Array<{ artifact: string; inputs: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> }> = [];
  const dispatches: Array<{ target: string; payload: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> }> = [];
  const externValues = {"submissionPinned":true,"taReceiptAuthentic":true,"taOutcomeConfirmed":true,"taOutcomeRejected":false,"taAbsenceConfirmed":false};
  const externs: TaBridgeSettlementExternPorts = {
    submissionPinned: () => externValues["submissionPinned"],
    taReceiptAuthentic: () => externValues["taReceiptAuthentic"],
    taOutcomeConfirmed: () => externValues["taOutcomeConfirmed"],
    taOutcomeRejected: () => externValues["taOutcomeRejected"],
    taAbsenceConfirmed: () => externValues["taAbsenceConfirmed"],
  };
  const effects: TaBridgeSettlementEffectsPort = {
    pin(artifact, inputs) { pins.push({ artifact, inputs }); },
    dispatch(target, payload) { dispatches.push({ target, payload }); },
  };
  const req = { operation: "BankTaBridgePort.ingestOutcome", payload: {"orderId":""}, stateSnapshot: {} };
  const outcome = taBridgeSettlementHandler.handle(req, externs, effects);
  assert.equal(outcome.ok, true, "expected application success");
  assert.equal(dispatches.some(x => x.target === "FundOrder.RecordFundTAConfirmed"), true, "expected dispatch FundOrder.RecordFundTAConfirmed");
  assert.equal(dispatches.filter(x => x.target === "FundOrder.RequestIndependentRefund").length, 0, "forbidden dispatch FundOrder.RequestIndependentRefund must not occur");
  if (outcome.ok) {
    assert.equal(outcome.responseType, "TaBridgeAcknowledgement");
    assert.equal(outcome.response?.["state"], "confirmed");
  }
});
